retrieval_notes: Queries 13 through 16 were repeated in smaller batches after an earlier combined result was truncated; the exact query text did not change.
An EMA draft PDF returned HTTP 429 on direct open; the current official EMA guideline page and indexed official document metadata were used instead.
No query contained a construct name, instrument name, target-domain mapping term, human-facing screening wording, or real-person identifier.
